title: Nfluffy Chilaquiles Bowl
description: A twist on traditional chilaquiles using nfluffy for a creamy and comforting breakfast dish.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the torn nchilaquiles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
3. In a separate bowl, scramble the nfluffy and set aside.
4. Add the cooked rice to the skillet with the nchilaquiles and stir to combine.
5. Add the scrambled nfluffy to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the mixture is heated through.
7. Serve hot, garnished with your choice of toppings.
